theorem_rows.name: Determinism
theorem_rows.statement: Two identically-seeded runs over the same inputs produce identical decision fingerprints (architecture, not luck).
theorem_rows.null: Fingerprints differ across identical seeded runs.

theorem_rows.name: Process over Outcomes
theorem_rows.statement: Every cycle exposes a decision_integrity in [0, 1] (the trajectory is scored, not just the terminal reward).
theorem_rows.null: Any cycle reports DI outside [0, 1] or omits it.

theorem_rows.name: Computational Conservation
theorem_rows.statement: Per-cycle compute consumed never exceeds the declared budget (ΣR_i ≤ R_max).
theorem_rows.null: Any cycle consumes more than 1.1× its budget.

theorem_rows.name: Possibility Preservation
theorem_rows.statement: At least one counterfactual alternative is stored every cycle (|F_t| ≥ 1).
theorem_rows.null: A cycle stores zero strategic options.

theorem_rows.name: Emergent Intelligence
theorem_rows.statement: At least two cognitive streams activate per cycle (no single stream is 'I').
theorem_rows.null: A cycle activates fewer than two streams.

theorem_rows.name: Kintsugi (System Memory)
theorem_rows.statement: A recorded failure structurally blocks a matching future intent (recency-scaled dissent), and does not block unrelated intents.
theorem_rows.null: A matching intent passes — failure was logged, not integrated.
theorem_rows.measured: matching blocked=True, unrelated passes=True, no-ledger passes=True

theorem_rows.name: Delayed Causality
theorem_rows.statement: The effective simulation horizon strictly exceeds the feedback lag (h_eff = max(h, τ + 1) > τ).

theorem_rows.name: Identity Projection (F(I))
theorem_rows.statement: An intent outside the identity projection F(I) is structurally inadmissible: the canonical IdentityProjectionGate admits only trajectories consistent with Core values, narrative role, and an active mission scope (the caller passes the REAL objective signal — genuine bootstrap only when no objective was ever defined), AND the SELECT phase enforces it end-to-end — an inadmissible SELECTED trajectory is projected out and replaced by the next-best admissible one (not merely logged).
theorem_rows.null: An identity-inadmissible intent (core-value violator, role-incompatible, or mission-less) survives F(I) projection.
theorem_rows.measured: projected_out=2/3, mission_block=True, value_block=True, role_block=True, reflex_admitted=True, select_enforced=True, missionless_enforced=True

theorem_rows.name: Constraint Propagation
theorem_rows.statement: A domain constraint violation propagates through the real ConstraintValidator and the blocking Council to a refused decision.
theorem_rows.null: A constraint-violating action passes validation (the constraint fails to block).

theorem_rows.name: Feedback Adaptation
theorem_rows.statement: The real InfrastructureManager.observe() loop adapts policy after a failure cluster (risk tolerance is lowered).
theorem_rows.null: A failure cluster leaves every policy parameter unchanged (the feedback loop is dead).

theorem_rows.name: Path Dependency
theorem_rows.statement: For an identical current state, a different interaction history yields a different semantic depth (π(s, H) ≠ π(s, H')).
theorem_rows.null: Identical current states yield identical semantic depth regardless of history.

theorem_rows.name: Maintenance vs Recovery
theorem_rows.statement: A sustained failure cluster drives the real InfrastructureManager into recovery mode before catastrophic failure.
theorem_rows.null: A sustained failure cluster never triggers recovery.

theorem_rows.name: Option Decay
theorem_rows.statement: Stale skills are archived (not deleted) by the real SkillLibrary and restored on reset_cycle — entropy falls without information loss.
theorem_rows.null: Pruning deletes a skill (active+archived total drops) and it cannot be restored.

theorem_rows.name: Adaptive Capacity
theorem_rows.statement: A mission policy swap replaces L_P parameters, is recorded in the audit trail, and leaves mission identity intact.
theorem_rows.null: A policy swap is unrecorded and/or loses the mission name.

theorem_rows.name: Structural Resilience
theorem_rows.statement: Two independent blocking mechanisms exist: the Council gate and the DecisionFirewall's own integrity check; each can refuse a proposal the other admits.
theorem_rows.null: A council-rejected or low-integrity proposal passes the firewall (no independent blocking).
